query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
           FROM search_index
           WHERE org_id = $1
             AND entity_kind = ANY($2)
             AND (
               tsv @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $3)
               OR ($4 AND title || ' ' || body ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%')
             )
             AND (
               entity_kind <> 'document'
               OR $5::uuid IS NULL
               OR client_scope IS NULL
               OR client_scope = $5
             )
